body: Looks like tree-sitter-bash is up-to-date now, so this is no longer needed.

I thought i had run into the same issue, so thinking it was a case of https://github.com/fitzgen/is_executable/issues/9 I patched

https://github.com/nix-community/patsh/blob/65d3e558a6d2270e42f6b28f03092c11f24cbb20/src/patch.rs#L86

to 

```rust
path.canonicalize().as_ref().unwrap_or(&path).is_executable().then_some(path)
```

but the act of updating `patsh.src` and `patsh.cargoDeps` in nixpkgs to my local checkout alone seems to fix the issues for me, making my patch irrelevant. Perhaps  we should cut a new release with all the merged dependabot bumps?

> updating `patsh.src` and `patsh.cargoDeps` in nixpkgs to my local checkout

Did you run `cargo update`?
Dang, this whole repo needs refactoring, `crane` changed a lot
